subject: Request: Combined security 'bridge-pack' for Argus Analytics marketplace listing
messages:
From: Julie Nichols <julie.nichols@argus-analytics.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@argus-analytics.com
Date: 2027-05-28T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Bridge-pack request for Argus marketplace listing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Argus is moving to prepare a single "bridge-pack" for the AWS and GCP marketplace listing and co-sell validation. The marketplace team asked for the following vendor artifacts as part of their security intake:

- SOC 2 Type II (most recent report — redacted is fine)
- Penetration test summary or letter of attestation
- Fully executed DPA or redline that we can route to our legal
- Encryption architecture diagram (KMS/HSM usage)
- Logging and retention policy brief (30/90/365 day retention details)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these, and what redaction policy is acceptable? We need the files in a vendor-friendly bundle by EOD Monday (May 31) to hit our marketplace onboarding window. If there's anything we can't share publicly, please flag it and we can accept controlled access (signed NDA or SecureDrop).

If useful, happy to do a 20 minute call with Karthik & Naomi to run through the acceptance checklist.

Thanks,

Julie Nichols
Head of Marketplace & Partnerships
Argus Analytics

Attachment: requested_scope_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Julie Nichols <julie.nichols@argus-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-28T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge-pack request for Argus marketplace listing

Julie — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a vendor bundle that matches the ask. High-level answers up front:

- SOC 2 Type II: we can provide the latest report with standard commercial redactions (customer names, IP addresses). We will label which sections are redacted and why.
- Pen test: we can supply a one-page summary + pen-test attestation letter. Full findings are behind a protected portal; we can provide an executive summary for marketplace review.
- DPA: attached is our current DPA redline (internal). We can execute via DocuSign or share a cleaned PDF for your legal review.
- Encryption diagram: included (high-level) showing KMS keys, HSM usage and key rotation cadence.
- Logging/retention: short policy doc (30/90/365) and an excerpt of our audit-log retention config.

I've attached preliminary redacted artifacts below for Argus to review. Please note a couple of constraints: the pen-test vendor prohibits publishing raw exploit code; SOC 2 attachments will have provider contact info redacted. If Argus needs access to unredacted items we can offer secure, time-limited access after a non-disclosure.

Owner / next steps (proposed):
- Soojin (security coordination) — package and redaction
- Karthik (commercial) — confirm DPA signature and commercial terms
- Marissa (partner ops) — marketplace upload steps and co-sell enablement contacts
- Naomi (legal ops) — routing DocuSign and procurement checklist

I can get the vendor bundle ready and send the final package by EOD Sunday (May 30). If that timeline works, Karthik can set a 20-minute handoff call on Monday to finalize acceptance.

Sincerely,

Soojin Lee
Senior Security Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (pdf); pen_test_summary_ARGUS_Q1_2027.pdf (pdf); DPA_Redline_ARGUS.docx (docx); encryption_architecture_diagram.png (png)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Julie Nichols <julie.nichols@argus-analytics.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridge-pack request for Argus marketplace listing

Julie — looping back. Thanks for the ask; Sunday delivery from Soojin works for Redwood. Proposed timeline and asks:

1) Sunday (May 30) EOB — Redwood sends redacted bundle (SOC2 + pen test summary + encryption diagram + DPA redline).
2) Monday (May 31) 20-minute call to confirm redactions and any additional procurement items (lines of business, billing entity).
3) If Argus needs unredacted artifacts, procurement/legal to confirm NDA; we will provide secure access window (48–72 hours) to the pen test portal.

For coordination: can you share the procurement contact and a HubSpot link to the deal? I'll attach the mutual action plan as a living Google Doc post-call. HubSpot deal id I've been given is ARG-2027-045; adding that to the thread so vendor ops can reference it.

Happy to host the call Monday at 10:00 AM PT if that suits Argus.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://hubspot.example/engagements/ARG-2027-045

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Julie Nichols <julie.nichols@argus-analytics.com>, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final delivery: Argus bridge-pack bundle (redacted)

Julie — delivering the redacted bridge-pack bundle for Argus as promised. Attached are the files referenced earlier. Summary of contents and notes below:

- redacted_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf — commercial redactions applied; sections noted in cover sheet.
- pen_test_summary_ARGUS_Q1_2027.pdf — 1-page executive summary + vendor attestation letter. Full report is available via secure portal on request.
- DPA_Redline_ARGUS.docx — our negotiated redline; comment bubbles call out non-standard terms (data residency, subprocessing). We can execute via DocuSign when Argus confirms final edits: https://docusign.example/sign/ABC123
- encryption_architecture_diagram.png — high-level diagram showing KMS/HSM keyflow, rotation cadence, and separation of duties.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Monday 10:00 AM PT short call to confirm redactions and DPA edits (Karthik will host).
2) If AWS marketplace needs additional attestations (e.g., SOC cover letter), we can produce a short vendor attestation within 48 hours.
3) For Argus procurement/legal who need the unredacted SOC2/pen-test, please confirm NDA and contact Naomi (naomi_feldman@redwood.com) for secure access.

If AWS marketplace (aws-marketplace@amazon.com) requires extra metadata for the listing (artifact manifest, SHA256 checksums, or signed attestations), include that ask on the call and we'll prioritize.

Thanks all — attaching files now.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Senior Security Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf; pen_test_summary_ARGUS_Q1_2027.pdf; DPA_Redline_ARGUS.docx; encryption_architecture_diagram.png
